labelsAndRules.baseline: Retained source-supported corrected baseline admissions, not a current-company census or verified tenancy. V7 corrects specific location/status fields only; CordenPharma admission is preserved without an independent eligibility review. Basel Orbis V6 classification remains unchanged.
labelsAndRules.research: Research counts are selected company/site observation assignment records, not unique or incremental companies. Source records may duplicate baseline entities and recur across locations; attached research sites remain retained even when not additional primary assignments. Institutional references are separate. No automatic company or ambiguous parent-alias merge.
labelsAndRules.primaryArea: Each baseline company and each selected research assignment record is assigned once per hub. Reviewed Adial current Glen Allen site and exact S38 address witness precede its unchecked Charlottesville import; unrelated primary assignments retain their previous reported-HQ/precision/stable-city selector. Supported signed/planned site is a non-operating fallback. Additional observations remain retained; not a new headquarters/eligibility census.
labelsAndRules.priority: Preserved V5 baseline analyst-priority model only; A/B/C are analyst assumptions, not credit. U and combined tier totals count assignment records, including overlapping research observations. Imported tiers excluded.
labelsAndRules.cash: Verified exact cash and cash equivalents only; numeric USD millions; period end 2025-11-04 or later; latest retained period per reporting entity; one allocation per hub; companywide reporting-entity context, not local capital or demand. Cash and investments excluded.
labelsAndRules.events: Dated retained physical actions in 2025-2026; planned/completed/unknown status preserved. No financing or clinical headline converted to footprint action.
labelsAndRules.nonadditivity: Company-region profiles and reporting-entity cash overlap across hubs; hub totals are not additive.
labelsAndRules.addressSites: Supported current address-matched sites are counted at their actual retained area, separately from single primary company assignments. Planned sites are excluded.
labelsAndRules.typedPlans: Typed plan records count only retained sites explicitly typed planned, planned_not_commissioned, or lease_signed_opening_not_confirmed. Separate planned/construction action evidence is not exhaustively tallied here. Zero typed plan records does not mean no planning actions.
